budget_equal: all six methods x all four rates x ten seeds x four families x two betas x 5000 interactions
deployed_clock: per-interaction environment + decision (including averaging/exploration) + buffer insertion and training; excludes initialization, diagnostics, logging and checkpoint I/O
failed_candidate: any nonfinite/failure invalidates entire candidate; report all; require at least one valid rate per method
pilot_diagnostics: observed reward only; no oracle outcome summaries used for selection
selection: maximize mean observed cumulative reward / 5000 over all 80 environments per method; ties choose smaller rate; no true means or regret supplied to selector
time_budget_rule: 4 times median deployed seconds among the 80 selected-rate DIRECT pilot runs; freeze numerical seconds before N3
